```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert a DOCX file to PDF and email it to a recipient.

Prerequisites:
  - Python 3.6+
  - LibreOffice installed and available on PATH
    (apt-get install libreoffice / brew install --cask libreoffice)

Usage:
  python3 convert_and_email.py

  You can also override defaults via environment variables:
    SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS
"""

import os
import subprocess
import smtplib
import sys
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Configuration – edit these to match your setup
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
DOCX_PATH = "docs/customer_report.docx"
PDF_OUTPUT_DIR = "docs"  # directory where the PDF will be saved

EMAIL_TO = "bob@example.com"
EMAIL_FROM = os.getenv("SMTP_USER", "you@example.com")
EMAIL_SUBJECT = "Customer Report"
EMAIL_BODY = "Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards"

SMTP_HOST = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.getenv("SMTP_USER", "you@example.com")
SMTP_PASS = os.getenv("SMTP_PASS", "")  # set via env var for security
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────


def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: str, output_dir: str) -> Path:
    """Convert a DOCX file to PDF using LibreOffice in headless mode."""
    docx = Path(docx_path)
    if not docx.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: '{docx}' not found.")

    out = Path(output_dir)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"Converting '{docx}' to PDF ...")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "libreoffice",
            "--headless",
            "--convert-to", "pdf",
            "--outdir", str(out),
            str(docx),
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )

    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(
            f"LibreOffice conversion failed (exit {result.returncode}):\n"
            f"{result.stderr}"
        )

    pdf_path = out / docx.with_suffix(".pdf").name
    if not pdf_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: Expected PDF '{pdf_path}' was not created.")

    print(f"PDF created: {pdf_path}")
    return pdf_path


def send_email(pdf_path: Path) -> None:
    """Send an email with the PDF attached via SMTP/TLS."""
    if not SMTP_PASS:
        sys.exit(
            "Error: No SMTP password set. "
            "Export SMTP_PASS before running this script."
        )

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = EMAIL_SUBJECT
    msg["From"] = EMAIL_FROM
    msg["To"] = EMAIL_TO
    msg.set_content(EMAIL_BODY)

    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        msg.add_attachment(
            f.read(),
            maintype="application",
            subtype="pdf",
            filename=pdf_path.name,
        )

    print(f"Sending email to {EMAIL_TO} via {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT} ...")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
        server.send_message(msg)

    print("Email sent successfully.")


def main() -> None:
    pdf_path = convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_OUTPUT_DIR)
    send_email(pdf_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
